FRIGITD: Budget Inception to Date

From the ORA eTraining module "Navigating Banner: Essentials for Research Administration" (lesson 5 of 12).
FRIGITD: Budget Inception to Date
Unlike FGIBDST, Native Banner's FRIGITD page is the ideal view for projects with performance periods that do not match the University fiscal year. This page shows a project's budget for a selected date range and allows the user to set the start and stop dates of the query to reflect their project's performance period.
Complete the content above before moving on.
FRIGITD: Budget View by Date Range
Summary
Native Banner: FRIGITD Page
Make your way to the Native Banner landing page, type the page code FRIGITD in the search bar, and select "Grant Inception to Date".
Enter Query Details
Start by entering your project's Index then hit "Enter" on your keyboard twice to populate the remaining fields. Then, review your query start and stop dates. The default will be from the start of the project to present (inception to date), but can be edited to reflect any performance period required. Once you have the correct dates entered click on the "Go" button in the upper right corner of the screen.
FRIGITD Budget Detail
Your project budget will populate with a view very similar to the FGIBDST page. You will be able to review your pool level budgets, charges against each pool, and active project encumbrances.
Want a Clean Budget View?
Both of the default views for FRIGITD and FGIBDST can be overwhelming to understand with all pool level accounts expanded. You can simplify your overall budget availability by pool level by changing one section of the query section. Repeat Step 2, but change "Account Summary" to "Budget Pool". Then, click on "Go" in the upper right corner.
Simplified Available Balance
This view condenses all accounts under each pool level into a singular total figure. This results in a clean presentation of your project's budget pool levels. This will help you verify that you have sufficient funds in a pool level before submitting requests.
